scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: DB_PORT=${DB_PORT:-5433} vitest run tests/contract/*.integration.test.ts tests/database/*.integration.test.ts tests/repositories/*.integration.test.ts tests/routes/*.integration.test.ts tests/services/*.integration.test.ts --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:db:up: docker compose -p log-ingestion-test -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --build postgres migrate
scripts.test:db:down: docker compose -p log-ingestion-test -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.test.yml down --volumes
